name: smwmusic-bloodstained-curse-of-the-moon-defiler-of-taboos
title: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon - Defiler of Taboos
description:
Another hit from Bloodstained. This one is from Curse of the Moon. I used 8bit samples for everything but the drums to match the original piece. It is your typical fast paced, Castlevania style track.

There are 2 version included, 1 removes the 2 beat intro. I couldn't decided which I prefer so I just submitted both.

Thanks to musicalman for all the 8bit/Pulse Duty samples.
